passives.name: DoflamingoEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
Every {1} $RegularAttack will $DoflamingoCocoon the enemies hit: 
- Enemies are either stunned for {2} hits, or {3} seconds
If the $DoflamingoCocoon is broken after {2} hits:
- Deal {4}% of this unit's current damage
If the $DoflamingoCocoon is not broken before {3} seconds:
- $DoflamingoCocoon despawns
